display_long_description:
**A VR full-body narrative survival experience set in the Star Trek universe.** 

You’re a Vulcan Starfleet officer, sent on a special mission aboard the U.S.S. Lumen, but something has gone horribly wrong.  There’s no crew in sight, and an unknown entity has infested the ship. Now it’s inside your body, physically mutating you, unlocking dangerous new abilities at the cost of your sanity.[media]

**Explore the U. S. S. Lumen**

Withstand or embrace the infection inside you. Confront the darkness within the ship… and your mind.  [media]

**Tend to Your VR Body**  

Inhabit a full-body avatar. Use your Medical Tricorder to track your condition, treating your infection with a Hypospray, or embracing its mutations. [media]

**Meld With Dangerous DNA**  

Manage or exploit your mutation’s side effects to unlock powerful but unstable abilities. [media]

**Face Horrors in Your Mind**  

You’re a Vulcan. Rational, disciplined, in control. But your sanity and resolve are faltering. Something aboard is learning your fears and using them against you. [media]

**Set Phasers to Stun & Scan for Life**  

Use your Phaser, stealth, or Vulcan nerve pinch to deal with threats. Use your Tricorder to scan for dangers and uncover vital resources.  [media]

**Get Your Hands Dirty**  

Use your VR hands to interact with the ship, crafting tools and weapons essential for survival. [media]
